capabilities: , Manage daily, weekly, and monthly tasks.
Complete daily and historical review cycles.
Create AI profiles from accumulated records.
Suggest future plans based on review outcomes.
extras: Freemium model; full AI and Insights require paid Pro license; license key stored securely using Obsidian SecretStorage.
intentEvidence: TideLog turns your Obsidian Daily Notes into a Plan → Review → Insights loop.
motivation: To transform passive daily note archiving into an active feedback system that drives behavioral change and provides long-term self-understanding.
problem: Users often record daily notes and reflections but lack a mechanism to connect those records back to actionable changes or long-term insights.
summary: TideLog transforms Obsidian Daily Notes into a closed loop system of planning, reviewing, and generating AI insights from accumulated records.
